title: Power Up
blurb: Four notes climbing, and something has just got measurably stronger. Arcade games needed a way to communicate an upgrade instantly and without text, so the ascending arpeggio became a universal grammar — you know what has happened even if you cannot see what changed. That is why it still works on things that are not games. Streamers wire it to sub alerts, editors drop it on glow-up montages, and it lands beautifully when applied ironically to the smallest possible achievement. Synthesised from scratch in the arcade tradition, original and free for any project.
origin: Original 8-bit style ascending arpeggio in the arcade power-up tradition.
